CFB:cfb.officials.source_or_reason: Crew assignments not published pregame in any open API; ESPN summary lists officials only post-game; CFBD has no assignments. Conference-level penalty rates from CFBD play data would be a different input.

CFB:cfb.wr_personnel_rate.source_or_reason: Personnel (11/12 etc.) from PFF/SIS/charting only; CFBD and ESPN play data lack personnel. Paid or non-permitted.

CFB:cfb.qb_interception_propensity.source_or_reason: Turnover-worthy plays are PFF-proprietary grading. Only raw INT rate derivable via CFBD (key needed), which is a different input.

NBA:nba.pot_ast.source_or_reason: Tracking passing data from stats.nba.com (not in permitted endpoint list; ESPN box/pbp has no potential assists).

NBA:nba.matchup_def.source_or_reason: Matchup data from NBA tracking/Synergy; paid or not permitted; ESPN pbp lacks it.

NBA:nba.co_creator_load.source_or_reason: Proxy from owner's nba-edge-finder archive (player_games with usage proxies fga/fta/tov/ast, pbp 2024-25+ for on-court inference); pregame lineup ex-ante needs prior-game data only.

NBA:nba.rim_contest_volume_on_court.source_or_reason: Contests are NBA tracking data (stats.nba.com), not permitted; ESPN pbp lacks contest flags; on-court rim protector identity not in archive columns.

needs: NBA hustle stats (deflections, contested shots, loose balls, charges, screen assists, boxouts)
NBA:nba.hustle_stat_index.source_or_reason: Hustle stats served only by stats.nba.com tracking endpoints, not in the permitted list; ESPN lacks most categories.

CBB:cbb.shot_zones.source_or_reason: ESPN public JSON game summary/pbp (site.api.espn.com) has shot x/y for many games; owner's ledger has only scoreboard so far, needs a backfill collection. Coverage uneven by conference.

CBB:cbb.first_half_minutes.source_or_reason: ESPN public summary/pbp endpoints; backfill of prior games needed (ledger holds scoreboard only). Use prior games' first-half minutes and fouls only.

CBB:cbb.lineups.source_or_reason: ESPN public pbp substitution events allow stint reconstruction; backfillable via site.api.espn.com summary for 2022+; not yet in owner archive.

needs: ESPN CBB pbp with clock times
CBB:cbb.possession_length_profile.source_or_reason: Possession lengths derivable from ESPN pbp clock and events; backfillable; needs collection.

CBB:cbb.player_shot_mix_xpps.source_or_reason: Same ESPN pbp shot-location source; backfillable but coverage uneven; needs collection run.

CBB:cbb.assist_conversion_chain.source_or_reason: Potential assists not in ESPN; only actual assists/assisted shares derivable from pbp (partial input). Source ESPN pbp, backfillable.

needs: ESPN CBB pbp three-point shot locations and context
CBB:cbb.three_shot_quality_xp.source_or_reason: ESPN pbp coordinates for 3PA with assisted flag; no defender distance, so context is limited; backfillable.

CBB:cbb.kenpom_rank_projection.source_or_reason: KenPom is paid; replication needs Torvik (scraping not permitted) or own ratings from ESPN scores, which is a different input.

CBB:cbb.kenpom_game_update_sensitivity.source_or_reason: Requires KenPom ratings history (paid); own-replication route needs full possession data and rating vintage.

needs: bracket and seeding from ESPN scoreboard
CBB:cbb.team_postseason_games_projection.source_or_reason: Results and tournament games in ESPN scoreboard (owner ledger 2022-2026) can drive projection; bracket vintages need capture; Wikipedia (approval) optional. Seeding/rankings are retrieval-time.

MLB:mlb.mlbb_team_rating_series_format.source_or_reason: Esports MLBB results: Liquipedia (scraping/API terms restrict), no permitted open API. Wikipedia sparse. Not in MLB Stats API.

SOCCER:soc.player_xg.source_or_reason: StatsBomb open data has player shots/xG but only select competitions; major-league player xG is Opta/FBref/Understat (not permitted). Partial coverage only.

SOCCER:soc.score_state.source_or_reason: Goal times/cards/subs available from openfootball and ESPN public JSON; StatsBomb open for selected comps; backfillable.

SOCCER:soc.penalty_rate.source_or_reason: Penalty events from openfootball/ESPN/StatsBomb; football-data.co.uk lists referees for some leagues; designated taker needs lineups. Backfillable.

SOCCER:soc.xi_strength_delta.source_or_reason: Player quality needs Transfermarkt/Opta/FBref (not permitted); XI itself from ESPN pregame ~1h before, vintage only.

SOCCER:soc.var_intervention_rate.source_or_reason: ESPN commentary/play events flag VAR decisions; coverage partial; StatsBomb open data has VAR tags in some comps. Backfillable partly.

SOCCER:soc.first_goal_hazard.source_or_reason: Goal minute data openly available (openfootball, ESPN, StatsBomb); backfillable to many seasons.

SOCCER:soc.penalty_shootout_skill.source_or_reason: Shootout results in openfootball cups and ESPN; kicker order via StatsBomb open or Wikipedia (host approval). Small samples.

SOCCER:soc.preseason_prior.source_or_reason: Market value is Transfermarkt (not permitted); promoted-team prior derivable from football-data.co.uk but market-value prior not. ClubElo on hold.

SOCCER:soc.player_minutes_expectation.source_or_reason: Historical minutes from FBref/Transfermarkt not permitted; ESPN public box scores give minutes, but expected-lineup news is a vintage-only feed; partial only.

SOCCER:soc.award_vote_distribution.source_or_reason: Ballon d'Or and other award vote shares are tabulated on Wikipedia (CC BY-SA), requires owner host approval; vintages immaterial.

SOCCER:soc.keeper_workload.source_or_reason: football-data.co.uk has shots/SOT by match for major leagues; backfillable; expected SOT faced derived from team rates.

SOCCER:soc.weaker_side_big_chance_creati.source_or_reason: Big chance and box-entry data are Opta/FBref only; StatsBomb open covers few comps.

SOCCER:soc.half_specific_xg_ratings.source_or_reason: Half-time goals from football-data.co.uk; half-specific xG only for StatsBomb open comps. Goal-based half ratings feasible.

SOCCER:soc.friendly_match_intensity.source_or_reason: Friendly results from openfootball/ESPN; effort/rotation indices need lineups and player values; value data not permitted. Largely partial.

needs: match goals, shots, cards from football-data.co.uk
SOCCER:soc.shared_openness_latent_factor.source_or_reason: Latent factor fits on football-data.co.uk match stats (shots, corners, fouls, goals); fully backfillable.

needs: corner events with minute and score state
SOCCER:soc.corner_state_multiplier.source_or_reason: football-data.co.uk has corner totals only; minute-level corners from ESPN events/StatsBomb open; partial coverage.

SOCCER:soc.assist_set_piece_role.source_or_reason: Assist type needs event data; StatsBomb open for selected competitions only; ESPN lacks pass types. Partial.

SOCCER:soc.keeper_saves_from_sot_and_psx.source_or_reason: SOT and saves from football-data.co.uk/ESPN; PSxG only in StatsBomb open (limited) or Opta. Partial.

SOCCER:soc.wc_award_selection_profile.source_or_reason: Golden Ball shortlist and winners on Wikipedia (CC BY-SA, host approval needed); openfootball World Cup data for team progress.

SOCCER:soc.country_first_tournament_goal.source_or_reason: First-goal scorer history from openfootball and StatsBomb open (WC/Euro); squads from Wikipedia need approval; backfillable.

SOCCER:soc.champion_path_trailing_probab.source_or_reason: Historical champion match scores/goal minutes available; sample tiny; derived from open data.

SOCCER:soc.extra_time_phase_scoring_rate.source_or_reason: Extra-time goals with minutes in openfootball/ESPN; backfillable, small sample.

SOCCER:soc.return_to_play_timeline.source_or_reason: Injury timelines come from Transfermarkt/Physioroom (not permitted) or club news; Wikipedia approval would only cover major injuries.

SOCCER:soc.season_boundary_strength_rese.source_or_reason: Cross-season strength change measurable from football-data.co.uk multi-year results; squad turnover needs market data (not permitted).

needs: live point-by-point feed with medical events

TENNIS:ten.shot_clock_and_violation_stat.source_or_reason: Time violations only in ATP/WTA live feeds or broadcast; not permitted.

TENNIS:ten.first_serve_speed_trend.source_or_reason: Serve speed data from ATP/WTA/Hawk-Eye infosys (not permitted); Sackmann charting lacks speeds for most matches.
